label: Point 7.0 cm
description: The classic Point collar at 7.0cm is the most timeless of dress shirt collars — moderate in length, with a slight downward angle that suits a wide range of face shapes and tie knots. It occupies the sweet spot between the long traditional point and the casual button-down, lending a shirt a polished formality without appearing severe. This collar stands well against a jacket lapel and is the standard choice for most bespoke shirtmakers seeking understated elegance.
